title: Density Area
intent: Create a smooth one-dimensional density estimate and render it as one or more filled area profiles.
useWhen: Use this recipe when distribution shape should be compared without committing to visible histogram bins.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe for very small samples or when exact counts per fixed bin are required.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

inputs.description: Task-specific field names, resource identifiers, and supported visual or statistical choices.

outcomes: Create a smooth one-dimensional density estimate and render it as one or more filled area profiles.

steps.instruction: Create the data, marks, encodings, and owned resources required before authoring the density area result.
Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable density area result or workflow.
Use the focused lifecycle actions only after their owned density area resources exist and are uniquely targeted.

pitfalls.problem: Implicit targeting fails when several compatible datasets, marks, scales, guides, or owners exist in the same program.
pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.
